title: Restricted-weight fixed-coordinate samples
statement: Let $n$ be the dimension of a restricted-weight input and let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. For each index in the sample set determined by the outer input, take the corresponding generator sample and project it onto the indices outside $J$, obtaining an element of $\mathbb{F}_2^{\mathrm{Fin}(n)\setminus J}$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the input's coordinate indices
caveat: The fixed-coordinate projection and generator-sample constructions are not defined in the supplied definitions.
